name: FP&A — CPG Channel Mix
description: Financial Planning & Analysis schema for CPG companies with multi-channel sales, regional forecasting, and close-cycle automation.

nodeTypes.label: CHANNEL_TAXONOMY
nodeTypes.description: Canonical sales channel definition with alias mappings and GM bands (e.g., DTC, Amazon, Wholesale).

nodeTypes.label: SKU_MASTER
nodeTypes.description: Product SKU reference data with pricing, cost, margin targets, and lifecycle status.

nodeTypes.label: CURRENCY_REGISTRY
nodeTypes.description: Active currencies with magnitude conventions and FX source priority.

nodeTypes.label: CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS
nodeTypes.description: P&L line items and GL account mappings.

nodeTypes.label: FX_FORWARD_CURVE
nodeTypes.description: Forward exchange rate data for M+1/M+2/M+3 horizons across currency pairs.

nodeTypes.label: REGIONAL_FORECAST
nodeTypes.description: Regional sales forecast workbook submission (AMER, EMEA, APAC) with units, ASP, and revenue by SKU/channel.

nodeTypes.label: FORECAST_ADJUSTMENT
nodeTypes.description: Post-submission adjustment to a forecast line item with audit trail.

nodeTypes.label: BANK_TRANSACTION
nodeTypes.description: Individual bank account transaction with GL account classification.

nodeTypes.label: VARIANCE_TRIAGE
nodeTypes.description: Detected variance pattern type (miscoded SKU, channel mismatch, currency tag, calendar shift) with auto-fix policy.

nodeTypes.label: DATA_QUALITY_FLAG
nodeTypes.description: Data quality signal detected in a source document (FAIL, REVIEW, WARN, etc.).

nodeTypes.label: CONTROL_ASSERTION
nodeTypes.description: Validation control with severity (hard/soft), owner, and threshold.

nodeTypes.label: CLOSE_STEP
nodeTypes.description: A step in the monthly close process with phase, timing, inputs/outputs, and automation status.

nodeTypes.label: PIPELINE_COVERAGE
nodeTypes.description: Pipeline coverage ratio metric (active pipeline / forecast) with target bands.

nodeTypes.label: CASH_CONVERSION_CYCLE
nodeTypes.description: Cash conversion cycle metric (DSO + DIO - DPO) with trend data.

nodeTypes.label: FREE_CASH_FLOW_MARGIN
nodeTypes.description: Free cash flow margin metric (FCF / revenue).

nodeTypes.label: ROIC_DECOMPOSITION
nodeTypes.description: Return on invested capital DuPont decomposition (margin x turnover x leverage).

nodeTypes.label: APPROVAL_ROLE
nodeTypes.description: Canonical approval role in the authority matrix (VP FP&A, CFO, Controller, etc.).

nodeTypes.label: PERSON
nodeTypes.description: Named individual with role, email, and organizational context.

nodeTypes.label: TABLE
nodeTypes.description: Structured table extracted from a document or spreadsheet.

nodeTypes.label: SPREADSHEET
nodeTypes.description: An Excel workbook or Google Sheets document containing one or more table sheets.

nodeTypes.label: EMAIL_MESSAGE
nodeTypes.description: An email message with sender, recipients, subject, and attachment references.

relationshipTypes.description: Inverse of CONTAINS — child is part of parent.
A control or process step validates data in another entity.
Document is the original source of derived data.
Document is attached to an email or message.
An action or document is approved by a person/role.
A forecast or document was submitted by a person.
One entity provides input data to another (e.g., forecast feeds into P&L projection).
One entity is computed from another (e.g., ROIC derives from margin + turnover).
A transactional entity references a taxonomy entity for classification.
A forecast adjustment modifies a forecast line item.
Email was sent by a person.
Email was sent to a person.
A variance or flag is escalated to a person/role.
One entity triggers evaluation of another (e.g., DQ flag triggers control assertion).
